questions.prompt: The Gunpowder Plot of 1605 aimed to destroy which building?
questions.fact: Guy Fawkes was caught guarding the barrels beneath the chamber, though he was not the plot's leader.

questions.prompt: Which state of matter has a definite volume but no definite shape?
questions.fact: Water is unusual in that its solid form is less dense than this one, which is why ice floats.

questions.prompt: The Paralympic classification system primarily groups athletes by what?
questions.fact: Codes such as T44 or S9 combine a letter for the discipline with a number describing the impairment class.

questions.prompt: Which rapper won a Pulitzer Prize for Music in 2018?
questions.fact: It was the first time the award went to a work outside the classical or jazz traditions.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Greece?
questions.fact: Its ancient rival Sparta left almost no monuments, which is partly why one city dominates our picture of the period.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'The Remains of the Day'?
questions.fact: He has said he wrote the first draft in four weeks of near-total isolation that his household called the Crash.

questions.prompt: Which version control system was created by Linus Torvalds?
questions.fact: He wrote the first working version in about ten days, after the tool Linux had been using withdrew its free licence.
